name: Mitsuki
source:
Mitsuki is an ordinary school-girl whose life is shrouded in a veil of secrets.

She played an important role in the lives of Aki and the "three Graces", but the true cause of her death remains a mystery.

Mitsuki has a very lively, pretty face. She can easily adapt to any situation [Spoiler]and portray the right emotion.

With how adept Mitsuki is at getting into different roles, she would've been a great actress.[/spoiler]

[i]"We all are cursed. The curse devours us from the inside".[/i] 

[Based on the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753200]official art-book[/url]]
